- Added `[agents.*]` sections to `.pcae/policy.toml` for the three default agents.
- Added `recommend_agent` helper in `src/pcae/core/orchestration.py` to match a work type against agent roles and return the best governed agent.
- Added `pcae orchestration recommend --work-type TEXT` to recommend an agent for a given work type, with role-based matching and deterministic fallback to `default_agent`.
- Added `pcae orchestration recommend --work-type TEXT --json` for machine-readable recommendation output including `work_type`, `recommended_agent`, `reason`, `matched_role`, and `fallback_used`.
- Added standard Python bytecode patterns (`__pycache__/`, `*.py[cod]`) to `.gitignore` to prevent governance false positives from installed package artifacts.
- Extended `pcae phase handoff` with `--work-type TEXT` to recommend the next agent via orchestration policy when `--next-agent` is omitted.
- When `--work-type` is provided without `--next-agent`, the recommended agent is used as the next agent and the recommendation reason is shown.
- When both `--work-type` and `--next-agent` are provided, the explicit agent is authoritative; human output shows the recommendation and whether it matches or was overridden.
- Added recommendation metadata to `pcae phase handoff --json`: `work_type`, `recommended_agent`, `recommendation_reason`, `recommendation_used`, `explicit_next_agent`.
- Added `_WORKFLOW_STEPS` built-in templates for `documentation`, `implementation`, `validation`, and `release` workflows in `src/pcae/core/orchestration.py`.
- Added `_resolve_agent` private helper to share role-to-agent resolution between `recommend_agent` and `build_workflow_plan` without double-loading the policy.
- Added `build_workflow_plan` in `src/pcae/core/orchestration.py` to produce ordered workflow steps using orchestration policy and agent registry, with deterministic fallback to `default_agent` for unknown workflows.
- Added `pcae orchestration plan --workflow TEXT` and `pcae orchestration plan --workflow TEXT --json` to generate governance-aware workflow plans with assigned agents and reasons per step.
- Added `pcae orchestration simulate --workflow TEXT` and `pcae orchestration simulate --workflow TEXT --json` to preview ordered execution steps, assigned agents, reasons, and governance checkpoints without executing work or changing locks.
- Revised orchestration and handoff language so policy-guided agent choices are clearly advisory; explicit `--next-agent` values are shown as user overrides.
- Added `pcae orchestration validate --workflow TEXT` and `pcae orchestration validate --workflow TEXT --json` for advisory workflow coherence validation across registry membership, role coverage, deterministic ordering, fallback behavior, and governance checkpoints.
- Added `pcae phase handoff --workflow TEXT` to include advisory workflow validation, warnings, and governance checkpoints in human-readable and JSON handoff guidance.
- Added `pcae orchestration readiness --workflow TEXT` and `pcae orchestration readiness --workflow TEXT --json` to preview whether an advisory workflow is ready based on validation, governance checkpoints, registry membership, health/check state, and session continuity.
- Added `pcae governance audit` and `pcae governance audit --json` for lightweight read-only governance coherence auditing across project status, roadmap references, active task state, session continuity, provenance history, policy parsing, and agent registry presence.
- Added `pcae governance repair --dry-run` and `pcae governance repair --dry-run --json` for deterministic advisory governance repair planning previews without modifying files.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot --preview` and `pcae runtime snapshot --preview --json` for read-only previews of portable governed runtime snapshot contents.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot export` and `pcae runtime snapshot export --json` to write portable governed runtime snapshot JSON files under ignored `.pcae/runtime-snapshots/`.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot inspect PATH` and `pcae runtime snapshot inspect PATH --json` for read-only inspection of exported governed runtime snapshots with clear invalid-file failures.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot restore PATH --dry-run` and `pcae runtime snapshot restore PATH --dry-run --json` for advisory restore previews without changing runtime state.
- Added explicit runtime snapshot schema/version governance with snapshot kind, exporter version, compatibility status, and compatibility notes across export, inspect, and restore preview.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot compatibility PATH` and `pcae runtime snapshot compatibility PATH --json` for deterministic read-only compatibility analysis, including support level, required runtime section checks, future exporter warnings, and unknown kind handling.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot manifest` and `pcae runtime snapshot manifest --json` for deterministic read-only indexing of exported runtime snapshots with latest snapshot, compatibility metadata, support levels, and manifest summary counts.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot retention --dry-run` and `pcae runtime snapshot retention --dry-run --json` for read-only retention planning that keeps the latest five snapshots and marks older snapshots as prune candidates without deleting anything.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot lineage` and `pcae runtime snapshot lineage --json` for deterministic read-only lineage analysis of exported runtime snapshots, ordering by exported_at, grouping compatible snapshots into continuity chains with previous-snapshot references, recording incompatible snapshots as lineage breaks, reporting the latest lineage head, and including the advisory note that no snapshots are modified.
- Added `pcae runtime snapshot validate-restore PATH` and `pcae runtime snapshot validate-restore PATH --json` for read-only restore safety validation running nine checks: snapshot compatibility, support level, repo cleanliness (no uncommitted changes), session continuity, active task presence, policy configuration validity, agent lock safety (warns if another agent holds the lock), runtime snapshot lineage continuity status, and governance health/check status. Reports safe_to_restore, blocking issues, non-blocking warnings, and lineage status without restoring runtime state, modifying agent locks, or mutating any governance artifact.
- Added `pcae context pack --preview` and `pcae context pack --preview --json`
- Refreshed `pcae docs commands` generated output to cover all current CLI command groups: phase (`pcae phase start/complete/handoff`), status (`pcae status coherence`), governance (`pcae governance audit/repair`), runtime snapshot (all 10 subcommands including validate-restore and lineage), orchestration (all 7 subcommands), context (`pcae context pack --preview`), provenance (all 8 subcommands), session bootstrap, and docs self-reference. Refreshed `docs/COMMANDS.md` with `--force`. for a compact read-only governed context pack for AI agents. Reports active task (id/title), governance state (health status, check status, session continuity, agent lock state), orchestration state (policy summary, registered agents, default agent), provenance summary (event count, latest event), roadmap summary (current phase and next items parsed from PROJECT_STATUS.md), fixed operational rules (phase prompt authority, PROJECT_STATUS.md is background context, do not infer stale tasks, active task scope, always run pcae check and tests), validation commands (pcae health, pcae check, python -m pytest, git status), and the quality preservation advisory that the pack reduces context size but does not relax governance constraints. Does not write files, mutate runtime state, or weaken governance.
- Extended `pcae context pack --preview` and `pcae context pack --preview --json` with universal compact context quality improvements: scope boundaries (allowed and forbidden files parsed from the active task contract), bootstrap/handoff notes (`pcae session bootstrap --agent-id <id>` for fresh sessions, `pcae phase handoff` for agent transitions), orchestration advisory recommendation semantics (advisory recommendations are non-binding; the human user remains authoritative), universal agent note (vendor-neutral; not tailored to any specific AI agent or provider), and stale-context suppression rules. JSON output now includes `scope_boundaries` (allowed_files and forbidden_files lists) and `bootstrap_handoff_notes` (list of bootstrap and handoff instructions). Orchestration state now includes `advisory_recommendation_semantics`. Quality preservation note updated to "Optimization reduces context size without relaxing governance constraints."
- Added optional `--profile` flag to `pcae context pack --preview` for work-mode governed context profiles: `implementation` (emphasizes active task scope, allowed files, validation commands, roadmap, operational constraints), `documentation` (emphasizes roadmap, architecture/governance semantics, operational rules), `validation` (emphasizes health/check state, validation commands, provenance summary), and `handoff` (emphasizes session continuity, agent lock, provenance, bootstrap/handoff guidance, orchestration state). Unknown profiles fall back to the balanced universal profile with a clear warning. All profiles preserve governance safety, operational rules, validation expectations, phase prompt authority, active task boundaries, and vendor neutrality. JSON output includes `profile_type` and `emphasized_sections`; unknown profiles include `profile_warning`. Profiles optimize by work mode, not by vendor or model.
- Added `pcae session bootstrap --compact` for read-only compact governed bootstrap prompt generation. `--compact` mode builds on the context pack and work-mode profile system to produce a structured, token-efficient prompt suitable for fresh AI sessions, post-auto-compact recovery, cross-agent handoff, and token-efficient continuity restoration. The prompt includes active task, governance state (health/check/session/lock), current phase, profile emphasis, operational rules, validation commands, stale-context suppression, bootstrap/handoff guidance, orchestration advisory semantics, and a vendor-neutral note. Supports `--profile` for work-mode emphasis and `--json` for machine-readable output (fields: `advisory`, `bootstrap_prompt`, `governance_state`, `operational_rules`, `orchestration_state`, `profile_type`, `validation_commands`). Read-only: does not acquire locks, append provenance events, or mutate any governance state. Made `--agent-id` optional at the CLI level (validated in the handler when `--compact` is absent). Advisory: "Bootstrap compression reduces token usage without relaxing governance constraints."
- Added `pcae context export` to export a compact governed context pack as an ignored local artifact under `.pcae/context-packs/` (filename `context-pack-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.txt`). Reuses `build_bootstrap_prompt` content (compact bootstrap format). Supports `--profile` for work-mode emphasis and `--json` for machine-readable output (fields: `path`, `profile_type`, `exported_at`). Exported files are ignored by Git via `context-packs/` entry in `.pcae/.gitignore`. Does not inject prompts, sync remotely, or mutate governance state.
- Added `pcae continuity export` to export a portable governed continuity restore pack as an ignored JSON artifact under `.pcae/continuity-packs/` (filename `continuity-pack-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.json`). Combines runtime snapshot metadata, compact context pack, compact bootstrap prompt, active task summary, governance state, orchestration state, provenance summary, operational rules, validation commands, stale-context suppression rules, bootstrap continuity notes, and a vendor-neutral note. Supports `--profile` for work-mode emphasis and `--json` for machine-readable output (fields: `path`, `profile_type`, `exported_at`, `included_sections`, `continuity_summary`). Exported packs are ignored by Git via `continuity-packs/` entry in `.pcae/.gitignore`. Continuity packs are governance-complete, vendor-neutral, portable, and read-only exports: no automatic restore, prompt injection, remote sync, telemetry, or runtime mutation.
- Added `pcae continuity inspect PATH` to inspect exported continuity packs read-only. Reports pack validity, exported timestamp, profile type, included sections, continuity summary (active task, governance health/check, provenance event count, orchestration default agent, compact context pack presence, compact bootstrap prompt presence, stale-context suppression presence, vendor-neutral note presence), portability notes, safety notes, and the advisory "Continuity pack inspection is advisory; no runtime state is changed." Supports `--json` for machine-readable output (fields: `valid`, `exported_at`, `profile_type`, `included_sections`, `continuity_summary`, `portability_notes`, `safety_notes`, `advisory`). Raises a clear error for missing files, invalid JSON, non-object JSON, or missing required fields. Does not restore runtime state, mutate continuity packs, or modify governance artifacts.
- Added `pcae continuity compatibility PATH` to analyze compatibility of exported continuity packs against the current PCAE runtime. Runs nine checks: structure validity, required sections presence, governance state presence, compact bootstrap presence, operational rules presence, stale-context suppression presence, vendor-neutral note presence, runtime snapshot metadata compatibility, and future-version warning support. Reports support level (`supported`, `partially-supported`, `unsupported`), per-check pass/warn status, deduplicated warnings, governance continuity summary, portability summary, and the advisory "Continuity compatibility analysis is advisory; no runtime state is changed." Supports `--json` for machine-readable output (fields: `compatible`, `support_level`, `compatibility_checks`, `warnings`, `continuity_summary`, `advisory`). Raises a clear error for missing files, invalid JSON, or non-object JSON. Does not mutate continuity packs, restore runtime state, or modify governance artifacts.
- Added `pcae continuity manifest` to index exported continuity packs deterministically. Scans `.pcae/continuity-packs/` and returns pack count, latest pack, manifest entries sorted newest-first by exported_at, and compatibility summary counts (compatible/incompatible/supported/partially-supported/unsupported). Each manifest entry includes filename, exported_at, profile_type, governance_health, governance_check, active_task_id, compatibility_status, support_level, vendor_neutral, stale_context_suppression_present, and compact_bootstrap_present. Supports `--json` for machine-readable output (fields: `pack_count`, `latest_pack`, `manifest_entries`, `compatibility_summary`, `advisory`). Advisory: "Continuity manifests are advisory; the user remains authoritative." Does not mutate continuity packs, prune packs, restore runtime state, or modify governance artifacts.
- Added Phase 44C.1 documentation capability discovery: augments `pcae capability-discovery` with a static `_DOC_CAPABILITY_CATALOG` mapping agent_id → vendor-documented capabilities. Catalog entries: codex-local (subagent-coordination, skill-execution), claude-local (subagent-coordination, custom-agent-support), kimi-local (swarm-coordination). Documentation evidence produces at most `observed` confidence — never `validated` or `proven`. Added `"custom-agent-support"` to `CAPABILITY_CATEGORIES` (20 categories total). Discovery merges documentation evidence with CLI and runtime discovery: if a capability is already known (e.g. claude's subagent-coordination from CLI help), `documentation_reference` is appended to its existing evidence_sources without downgrading confidence; if unknown, a new `observed` entry is created. Documentation applies regardless of installation status. Future agents without catalog entries remain `unknown` and do not fail discovery. New evidence source label: `documentation_reference`. 10 new tests verifying per-agent doc promotion, max-observed constraint, multi-source accumulation, and future-agent isolation.
- Fixed Phase 44C capability auto-discovery: `subagent_capable_agents` was always empty because `_KW_CAP_SUBAGENT` only matched `("subagent", "sub-agent", "agent team")` — none of which appear in real CLI help texts. Expanded `_KW_CAP_SUBAGENT` (and the shared `_KW_SUBAGENTS` used by runtime discovery) to include `"background agent"` (matches Claude's "Manage background agents"), `"multi-agent"` (matches Claude's ultrareview command), and `"--agents"` (matches Claude's `--agents <json>` option). These keywords are vendor-neutral: any future CLI that uses the same terminology will be detected without code changes. Also integrated `build_runtime_discovery()` as a formal secondary evidence source in `build_capability_discovery()` — the runtime discovery result is passed into each per-agent profile build and contributes a `runtime_discovery` evidence source when `subagents_supported == "yes"`. Also made subcommand probing executable-agnostic (probes `exec`, `mcp`, `mcp-server` for any executable, not just codex). With these changes, `claude-local` is correctly detected as subagent-capable with confidence `observed` and evidence sources `["CLI help inspection", "runtime_discovery"]`. Added 4 new mechanism-level tests that verify: `subagent_capable_agents` is consistent with per-agent `subagent_profile.supported`; only approved evidence sources are cited; installed agents with subagent support report `observed` (not `unknown`); and CLI/runtime discovery is always in the evidence chain for observed subagent capabilities.
- Added `pcae capability-registry`, `pcae capability-registry --json`, `pcae capability-discovery`, and `pcae capability-discovery --json` (Phase 44C) for evidence-based agent capability auto-discovery. `capability-registry` shows the static capability registry (adapter contracts + execution history, no CLI probing); `capability-discovery` runs full auto-discovery (CLI help inspection + execution history + adapter contracts). Both cover 7 agents (codex-local, claude-local, kimi-local, deepseek-local, gemini-local, grok-local, perplexity-local) and 19 capability categories (planning, implementation, review, validation, research, testing, architecture, documentation, security, performance, dependency-analysis, data-science, devops, refactoring, code-generation, roadmap-generation, subagent-coordination, skill-execution, swarm-coordination). Per-agent profile includes agent_id, runtime, lifecycle_status, installed, version, capabilities (with name/confidence/evidence_sources/notes), and subagent_profile (supported/confidence/mechanism/evidence_sources/notes). Confidence levels: unknown → observed → validated → proven. Evidence sources: adapter_contract, manual_validation, runtime_discovery, CLI help inspection, governed_execution_history, writable_execution_history, documentation_reference. Discovery rules: subagent/skill/swarm capabilities are at most `observed` from CLI help (never proven); declared agents with no installation remain `unknown`; writable execution history promotes `implementation` to `proven`; governed execution history promotes code-generation/testing/validation to `proven`. JSON output: `capability_registry`, `discovery_summary`, `advisory`. Read-only: no agents executed, no prompts submitted. Advisory: "Capability registry is advisory; capabilities are evidence-based and should be refreshed after runtime updates." 24 new tests.
- Added `pcae orchestration-design` and `pcae orchestration-design --json` (Phase 44B) for read-only multi-agent orchestration architecture design. Covers: coordinator responsibilities (task_decomposition, role_assignment, parallel_execution_planning, result_collection, conflict_detection, consensus_calculation, governance_handoff); capability profile model (fields: agent_id, runtime, lifecycle_status, capabilities, writable_supported, subagent_supported, evidence_source, confidence; 13 capability categories: planning, implementation, review, validation, research, testing, architecture, documentation, security, performance, dependency-analysis, data-science, devops); five orchestration patterns (sequential, parallel_review, parallel_planning, swarm, full_pipeline); governance integration rules (only implementer may modify files; planner/reviewer/validator read-only by default; file modification requires existing governance; commit/push separately governed; human remains authoritative); conflict resolution policies (unanimous, majority, weighted, human_escalation; default: human_escalation); and future agent expansion (deepseek-local, gemini-local, grok-local, perplexity-local, future cloud/local agents). JSON output includes `orchestration_design`, `capability_profile_model`, `orchestration_patterns`, `governance_integration`, `conflict_resolution`, `future_agent_expansion`, and `advisory`. Strictly read-only — no orchestration executed, no agents spawned, no files modified. Advisory: "Multi-agent orchestration design is advisory; no orchestration is performed." 13 new tests.
- Added `pcae continuity retention --dry-run` and `pcae continuity retention --dry-run --json` for read-only retention planning that keeps the latest five continuity packs and marks older packs as prune candidates without deleting anything. Human-readable output reports pack count, keep count, prune candidate count, packs to keep, and prune candidates. JSON output includes `pack_count`, `keep_count`, `prune_candidate_count`, `keep`, `prune_candidates`, and `advisory`. Advisory: "Continuity retention planning is advisory; no continuity packs are deleted." Does not delete continuity packs, mutate continuity packs, restore runtime state, or modify governance artifacts.
- Added `pcae governance sync-check` and `pcae governance sync-check --json` for read-only governance artifact synchronization validation. Analyzes PROJECT_STATUS.md, tasks/TODO.md, CHANGELOG.md, and tasks/DONE.md to detect stale references (known completed features still listed as pending), completed TODO entries (pending items whose `pcae` commands appear in DONE.md or CHANGELOG.md), inconsistent roadmap entries (Next items whose commands appear in DONE.md), and governance audit capability gaps (checks absent from `pcae governance audit` — specifically `artifact_sync_drift`). Human-readable output reports synchronization status, stale references, completed TODO entries, inconsistent roadmap entries, and governance drift warnings. JSON output includes `synchronized`, `stale_references`, `completed_todo_entries`, `inconsistent_entries`, `governance_drift_warnings`, and `advisory`. Advisory: "Synchronization analysis is advisory; no governance artifacts are modified." Does not mutate artifacts, auto-repair TODO.md, rewrite PROJECT_STATUS.md, or modify CHANGELOG.md.
- Integrated `artifact_sync_drift` check into `pcae governance audit` and `pcae governance audit --json`. The new check runs `check_governance_sync` internally and passes when governance artifacts are synchronized or when drift issues are present (drift surfaces as warnings, not failures). Drift warnings from `find_artifact_sync_drift_warnings` report completed TODO entries still listed as pending and inconsistent roadmap entries; stale references continue to be reported by the existing `find_stale_roadmap_references` path without double-counting. Adding `artifact_sync_drift` to `_GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_KNOWN_CHECKS` closes the gap that `pcae governance sync-check` previously reported as a drift warning. The audit remains read-only: no artifacts are mutated, no TODO entries are removed, and no roadmap files are rewritten.
- Added `pcae governance sync-repair --dry-run` and `pcae governance sync-repair --dry-run --json` for deterministic read-only repair previews for stale governance artifacts with artifact-type-aware semantics: operational artifacts (tasks/TODO.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md) propose remove or update actions; historical artifacts (CHANGELOG.md, tasks/DONE.md) propose preserve actions and are never proposed for removal. Reuses existing `check_governance_sync` logic to generate per-repair entries for: completed TODO entries still pending (action: remove, artifact: tasks/TODO.md), stale roadmap/command references across governance artifacts (action: remove, per-artifact), inconsistent roadmap entries whose commands appear in DONE.md (action: remove, artifact: PROJECT_STATUS.md), and governance audit capability gaps (action: update, artifact: governance audit). Each repair entry includes the target artifact, stale entry, proposed action (remove/update/relocate), and rationale. Human-readable output shows "Governance synchronization repair preview", proposed repairs with artifact/stale_entry/action/rationale fields, and the advisory note "Repair preview is advisory; no governance artifacts are modified." JSON output includes `repairable`, `proposed_repairs` (list of artifact/stale_entry/action/rationale objects), and `advisory`. Does not modify governance artifacts, auto-repair TODO.md, rewrite CHANGELOG.md, or mutate runtime state.
- Added `pcae governance artifacts` and `pcae governance artifacts --json` to expose the governance artifact classification registry as a reusable read-only command (Phase 35S). Lists all 10 known governance artifacts grouped by class: operational (PROJECT_STATUS.md, tasks/TODO.md — repair: actionable, source control: tracked), historical (CHANGELOG.md, tasks/DONE.md — repair: preserve, source control: tracked), runtime (.pcae/provenance-history.json, .pcae/agent-lock.json, .pcae/session.json — repair: ignore, source control: ignored), and generated (.pcae/runtime-snapshots/**, .pcae/context-packs/**, .pcae/continuity-packs/** — repair: ignore, source control: generated_ignored). Human-readable output groups entries by class with repair policy label and source control role. JSON output includes `artifacts` (list of path, artifact_class, governance_role, repair_policy, source_control_role per entry), `classes` (ordered list of artifact classes), and `advisory`. Registry reuses `classify_governance_artifact` from Phase 35R. Does not mutate artifacts, modify source control, or change sync-check/sync-repair behavior. Advisory: "Artifact classification is advisory; the user remains authoritative."
- Added `pcae governance artifacts export` and `pcae governance artifacts export --json` for exporting the governance artifact classification registry as a portable ignored artifact (Phase 35U). Exports to `.pcae/governance-exports/artifact-registry-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.json`. Export file includes: `exported_at`, `exported_by_version`, `artifact_count`, `classes`, `artifacts` (with path, artifact_class, governance_role, repair_policy, and source_control_role per entry), and `advisory`. Human-readable output reports export path, artifact count, classes, and exported_at timestamp. JSON output includes export_path, exported_at, artifact_count, classes, and advisory. Added `.pcae/governance-exports/` to `.pcae/.gitignore` so export files are ignored by Git. Added `.pcae/governance-exports/**` to `GOVERNANCE_ARTIFACT_REGISTRY` and `_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_PREFIXES` so the classifier correctly recognizes export files as generated artifacts. Does not mutate governance artifacts, repair anything, or modify source control. Export-only command; registry import, automatic repair, and semantic analysis are not implemented.
- Added `pcae governance registry-audit` and `pcae governance registry-audit --json` for read-only audit of governance registry consumer coverage (Phase 35T). Reports whether key governance systems are registry-backed: sync-check (uses `classify_governance_artifact` via `_artifact_type_for`), sync-repair (uses `classify_governance_artifact` via `_artifact_type_for` and `_stale_ref_proposed_action`), governance audit (uses `classify_governance_artifact` via artifact_sync_drift check), and artifact registry (uses `GOVERNANCE_ARTIFACT_REGISTRY` directly). Human-readable output reports registry audit status, consumers checked with registry-backed status and note per consumer, warnings (none if all consumers are registry-backed), and advisory "Registry audit is advisory; no governance artifacts are modified." JSON output includes `registry_audit_status`, `consumers` (list of name/registry_backed/note per consumer), `warnings`, and `advisory`. Command is read-only: does not mutate artifacts, rewrite governance files, scan source beyond deterministic helpers, or modify any runtime state.
- Phase 136AX: repaired the lifecycle-reporting phase-ID grammar (`pcae.core.phase_reports`, `pcae.core.architecture_status`, `pcae.core.context`, `pcae.core.tasks`, `pcae.commands.phase`) that assumed exactly one mainline branch letter (`\d+[A-Z]`) — Track 136 rolled over into two-letter mainline suffixes (`136Z -> 136AA -> ... -> 136AW`), which the old grammar could not parse at all. This was the direct, reproduced root cause of `pcae architecture-status inspect` reporting "## Current Phase section present but its phase-ID/title line did not parse -- current phase could not be identified" and dropping the current phase's own "Recommended next phase" sentence for every phase from 136AA onward. `PHASE_ID_RE`/`_CANONICAL_TITLE_PHASE_ID_RE`/`_COMPLETED_PHASE_HEADER_RE`/`_PHASE_LABEL_LINE_RE`/`_CURRENT_PHASE_LINE_RE`/`_COMMIT_SUBJECT_PHASE_TOKEN_RE`/`_VALID_PHASE_ID_RE` and related base-phase-comparison regexes now accept `[A-Z]+` consistently. Also fixed wrapped-title truncation in the current-phase declaration line and the "Recommended next phase:" sentence (both previously stopped at the first physical newline / required line-start anchoring, silently truncating or missing this repository's actual hand-wrapped, mid-paragraph prose), `pcae.core.status.check_project_status_current_phase` (used by `pcae governance audit`) now reuses the same shared parser instead of a third, independently-truncating `first_line()` implementation, and `pcae.commands.task._read_lifecycle_current_phase_line` now reuses it too so an already-completed current phase is never misread as not-yet-completed due to its `(completed)` marker being on a later wrapped line. Also fixed three `pcae phase complete`/`pcae task finish` crash-safety gaps in `.pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json` reading: a malformed (non-int, non-list) `files_changed` no longer fabricates a count via `len()`; an explicit JSON `null` for `validation_results`/`governance_results` no longer crashes with `TypeError`; a non-dict list item no longer crashes with `AttributeError`. `pcae session bootstrap` now surfaces the last completed phase's own notification dispatch outcome (`Last phase notification: ...`, sourced from `latest.json`'s `notification_result` field, previously loaded but never printed) distinctly from Telegram sink configuration state, and its dash-splitting for active-task/recommended-phase comparison now handles en dash as well as em dash. See `docs/PHASE_136_LIFECYCLE_BOOTSTRAP_SESSION_STATE_REPORTING_REPAIR.md` for the full root-cause analysis, source-of-truth precedence table, and regression evidence. No Stage 3 schema or typed-authority-model change; no runtime capability change.
- Centralized governance artifact lifecycle classification in `classify_governance_artifact` and `ArtifactClassification` (Phase 35R). Replaces implicit `_HISTORICAL_ARTIFACTS` frozenset with a deterministic four-class registry: operational (PROJECT_STATUS.md, tasks/TODO.md — live guidance, actionable drift candidates), historical (CHANGELOG.md, tasks/DONE.md — preserved records, never proposed for removal), runtime (.pcae/provenance-history.json, .pcae/agent-lock.json, .pcae/session.json — runtime governance state, ignored for source repair), and generated (.pcae/runtime-snapshots/**, .pcae/context-packs/**, .pcae/continuity-packs/** — generated artifacts, ignored for source repair). `classify_governance_artifact(artifact)` returns an `ArtifactClassification` with `artifact_type`, `artifact_class`, and `governance_role`. `pcae governance sync-check` and `pcae governance sync-repair` now use the classifier for operational vs. historical vs. runtime vs. generated semantics. `SyncRepairEntry.to_dict()` now exposes `artifact_class` and `governance_role` in JSON output. Human-readable repair preview output now explicitly states that runtime and generated artifacts (.pcae/**) are ignored for source governance repair. Current behavior is preserved: operational artifacts remain actionable, historical artifacts remain preserved. Classifier is deterministic and read-only; no artifacts are modified.
- Completed Phase 143M: Interactive Workflow Evidence Coordination, Clarification, and Audit Infrastructure Implementation. Implemented three new sibling packages on top of Phase 143K's Session Infrastructure and Phase 143L's Transition Engine: `pcae.interactive_workflow.evidence` (`EvidenceItem` — immutable, no authority/approval/confirmation/CHGR field; `EvidenceCoordinator` — registration with duplicate rejection, content-deterministic ordering by `(collected_at, evidence_id)` independent of registration order, missing-evidence gap reporting), `pcae.interactive_workflow.clarification` (`Clarification` — immutable, copy-on-write; `validate_classification_tag` synchronously rejects recommendation/persuasion/approval/authorization/decision classification per IWC-001 v1.1 §9.1's four-act boundary; `ClarificationController` — request/response registration, duplicate and double-response rejection, immutable request-ordered history), and `pcae.interactive_workflow.audit` (`AuditEvent` — immutable, frozen payload, no authority metadata beyond `session_id`; `AuditRecorder` — append-only with duplicate rejection, append-order deterministic retrieval, immutable snapshot history). All three coordinators are scoped to one session identifier via the existing `session.identity.validate_session_id` syntax check and import neither `SessionCoordinator` nor `TransitionEngine` (passive structural integration, confirmed by a dedicated AST-based test). Added three sibling serialization modules (`evidence_schema.py`, `clarification_schema.py`, `audit_schema.py`) and a six-member error extension (`DuplicateEvidenceError`, `UnknownEvidenceError`, `DuplicateClarificationError`, `InvalidClarificationError`, `DuplicateAuditEventError`, `AuditSerializationFailureError`). 61 new unit/regression tests (`tests/test_iwc_143m_evidence_clarification_audit.py`). No decision selection, Preview Digest generation, confirmation, publication, or CHGR creation implemented; Session Coordinator (143K) and the Transition Engine (143L) not modified. Runtime unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable). Recommends 143N — Interactive Workflow Confirmation & Preview Infrastructure Implementation.
